Columbia Asset Management increased its stake in General Dynamics Corp (GD) by 305.25% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Columbia Asset Management bought 4,655 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.60% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,180 shares of the marine transportation company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.27M, up from 1,525 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Columbia Asset Management who had been investing in General Dynamics Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $66.86B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.49% or $1.11 during the last trading session, reaching $225.17. About 172,128 shares traded. General Dynamics Corporation (NYSE:GD) has risen 36.41% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 19.71% the S&P500. 
Seatown Holdings decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 71% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Seatown Holdings sold 112,884 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 46,116 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $7.11M, down from 159,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Seatown Holdings who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $891.05B market cap company. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
